summary: Check my logged-in web accounts for anything urgent, summarize it, and draft (but do not send) any replies that need my attention.
note: GENUINELY NEW — kept open with the remaining gaps named. Covered today: authenticated reads of up to 4 ALREADY-OPEN tabs merged into one cited brief (POST /research {mode:"page"}, local-agent/research.js readOpenTabs), and staged-not-sent form fill (POST /forms/fill). GAP (1) CLOSED 2026-08-07 — local-agent/originFanOut.js readOrigins() (POST /origins/read): several authenticated origins read for one question, per-origin results with provenance, evidence age and partial success. It addresses pages by URL rather than only seeing tabs the owner already has open, so the readOpenTabs cap of 4 no longer bounds this. MISSING: (2) no account/origin registry — nothing enumerates "my logged-in accounts", so the caller still supplies the origin list; (3) no urgency scorer over web content — local-agent/notificationTriage.js scores Mail.app envelopes only and has no page-text input; (4) no draft-reply generator — fillForm requires caller-supplied values and send_email a caller-supplied body; nothing composes either from page content; (5) no drafts store to hold "drafted but not sent".
